verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler-based UI framework for building web interfaces. Setting up autonomous background automations is a capability of agent or workflow platforms, so the axis does not fit this kind of product. The closest evidence does not count: the MCP server only helps an external agent write Svelte code, the subagents mention describes agent tooling rather than Svelte-run automations, and $effect is reactive UI logic, not scheduled or autonomous jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
